title: Future Plans
ringkas: will dan be going to, rencana liburan, dan prediksi
goals: membicarakan masa depan dengan [[will]] dan [[be going to]]
membedakan kapan memakai **will** dan kapan memakai **be going to**
membuat kalimat negatif: [[won't]] dan [[isn't going to]]
membuat pertanyaan: [[Will you ...?]] dan [[Are you going to ...?]]
memakai kata waktu masa depan: [[tomorrow]], [[next week]], [[tonight]], [[soon]]
bercerita tentang rencana liburan dan membuat prediksi

lesson.text: Apa rencanamu **akhir pekan ini**? Apakah besok akan hujan? Untuk membicarakan hal yang **akan terjadi**, bahasa Inggris punya dua cara populer: **will** dan **be going to**. Di **Unit 4** kamu belajar keduanya.

lesson.title: 2. Will + kata kerja dasar
lesson.text: Rumus: **subjek + will + kata kerja dasar**. Bentuk will **sama untuk semua subjek** (tidak ada -s). Singkatan: **I'll**, **she'll**, **they'll**.
table: [[I will call you tonight.]] / [[She'll help us.]]

lesson.text:
**Kapan memakai will?**
• **Keputusan saat berbicara:** [[The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.]]
• **Prediksi** (menurut pendapat): [[I think it will rain tomorrow.]]
• **Janji** dan tawaran: [[I will help you.]] / [[I promise I won't be late.]]

lesson.title: 3. Be going to + kata kerja dasar
lesson.text: Rumus: **am / is / are + going to + kata kerja dasar**. Dipakai untuk **rencana** yang sudah dipikirkan sebelumnya, dan **prediksi** yang ada buktinya.
table: [[I am going to visit my grandmother.]]
[[He isn't going to join the club.]]
Am/Is/Are + subjek + going to + kata kerja?
Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.

lesson.text:
**Kapan memakai be going to?**
• **Rencana:** [[We are going to visit Bali next month.]] (sudah direncanakan)
• **Prediksi dengan bukti:** [[Look at those dark clouds. It's going to rain.]]

lesson.title: 4. Will atau be going to?
table: [[I'm going to buy a new phone. I saved money.]]
ada bukti sekarang: [[Look! He's going to fall.]]

lesson.title: Jangan pusing
lesson.text: Dalam banyak situasi, kedua bentuk bisa dipakai dan artinya hampir sama. Pilih **be going to** untuk rencana yang jelas, dan **will** untuk keputusan mendadak, janji, atau dugaan.

lesson.title: Jangan campur
lesson.text: Setelah **will**, tidak boleh pakai to atau -ing. Benar: [[I will go.]] Salah: *I will to go* / *I will going*. Setelah **going to**, pakai kata kerja dasar: [[I'm going to study.]]

Bulan depan, keluargaku akan mengunjungi Bali. Kami akan menginap di hotel kecil dekat pantai selama empat hari.
Aku akan snorkeling dengan adikku. Ibuku akan membeli oleh-oleh, dan ayahku akan memotret banyak foto. Kukira liburan ini akan menyenangkan, tetapi aku berharap tidak hujan.

read.text:
Next month, my family is going to visit Bali. We are going to stay in a small hotel near the beach for four days.
I will go snorkeling with my brother. My mother is going to buy some souvenirs, and my father will take a lot of photos. I think it will be a wonderful holiday, but I hope it won't rain.
read.title: Holiday Plans

Pada hari Sabtu, cuaca akan cerah dan panas, sekitar tiga puluh derajat. Pada hari Minggu, angin kencang akan datang, dan perahu kecil tidak akan melaut.

read.text:
Tomorrow morning, it will be cloudy in Bandung. In the afternoon, it is going to rain heavily, so take an umbrella.

Next month, Dina and her family are going to visit Yogyakarta. They are going to take the train because it is cheaper. Dina is going to visit Borobudur Temple.
Her brother says, "It will be hot there. I will bring a hat." Her mother says, "I'll buy the tickets tomorrow." Dina thinks, "I think we will have a wonderful time. Maybe I will take many photos!"

read.id:
Besok ulang tahun Dina. Rani berkata, "Aku akan membawa kue. Aku tidak akan lupa, aku janji." Tom berkata, "Aku akan membantumu membawanya." Dina tersenyum. "Apakah kalian akan datang ke pestaku?" "Ya, kami akan datang."
"Apakah akan hujan?" tanya Dina. Rani memeriksa ponselnya. "Tidak. Ramalan cuaca bilang akan cerah." "Bagus! Kurasa kita akan bersenang-senang. Mungkin kita akan bermain game di kebun." Tom menambahkan, "Dan aku akan memotret semua orang."

qs.answer: I will take photos of everyone.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Aku akan memotret semua orang."

read.text:
Tomorrow is Dina's birthday. Rani says, "I will bring a cake. I won't forget it, I promise." Tom says, "I'll help you carry it." Dina smiles. "Will you come to my party?" "Yes, we will."
"Will it rain?" Dina asks. Rani checks her phone. "No, it won't. The forecast says it will be sunny." "Great! I think we'll have fun. Maybe we will play games in the garden." Tom adds, "And I will take photos of everyone."
read.title: Promises and Predictions

Rani: What are you doing on Saturday? Dina: I'm visiting my grandmother. I've already bought the bus ticket. And you? Rani: I'm going to clean my room. It's very messy! Maybe I'll watch a film afterwards.
Dina: I'm going to bake cookies for my grandmother. Do you want to come? Rani: Sorry, I can't. But I'll help you choose a recipe tonight. Dina: Thanks! I think she'll love the chocolate ones.
